whatIs.title: What is SetLux?
whatIs.lead1: SetLux is a tool designed to organize lighting department work in a clear, practical way, adapted to real shoots.

homeItem.title: Less on‑set improvisation
homeItem.description: All information centralized to reduce errors and time loss.

saveTime.title: Time savings
saveTime.description: Fewer duplicates, fewer scattered messages, and fewer errors.

reduceErrors.title: Reduce Errors
reduceErrors.description: Eliminate human errors with precise automatic calculations and smart validation at every step.

documentation.title: Professional Documentation
documentation.description: Generate high‑quality PDF documents ready to share with production and accounting.

transparency.title: Increase Transparency
transparency.description: All calculations are visible and verifiable, improving communication and legal compliance.

allInOne.title: All in One
allInOne.description: The only platform that integrates planning, team, conditions, reports and payroll in one place.

legal.title: Legal Compliance
legal.description: References to labor agreements and clear policies that make compliance easier.

features.label: FEATURES
features.title: Main features
features.subtitle: Essential tools to manage your department

labor.title: Project management
labor.description: Centralize technical information for each production in one place.

team.title: Team Management
team.description: Organize your lighting team with differentiated roles (Gaffer, Best Boy, Electrician, etc.) and teams (Base, Prelight, Wrap).

planning.title: Planning
planning.description: Complete shooting planning system with interactive calendar, week management, team assignment and professional export.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Advanced weekly reporting with overtime, turnarounds, night work, per diems, and all economic concepts.

payroll.title: Payroll
payroll.description: Automatic monthly payroll calculation with detailed breakdown of days worked, extra concepts and accounting export.

needs.title: Needs
needs.description: Manage all department needs during production with customizable lists and professional export.

cta.title: Organize your work with more clarity.
cta.text: SetLux is in active development and we’re looking for professionals to test it.
